title: GA4 BigQuery events export — data contract
surface: GA4 BigQuery Export daily events_ table (core scalar columns)
who_uses_this: Validate a client's GA4 BigQuery events export before building reporting models on top of it, or with POST /egress before feeding a subset to an AI agent or reverse ETL.
description: GA4 BigQuery Export events — core scalar columns of the daily events_ table. Compatible with Google Analytics 4's documented BigQuery export schema; not affiliated with Google. Nested RECORD columns (event_params, user_properties, items) are omitted from this core contract.
